data.exact_reserve_text: Overall premium for the year has decreased to GBP 387.8m (2017: GBP 396.6m), with the loss for the financial year of GBP 25.0m reflecting the challenging market conditions currently being faced, higher than expected attritional losses in the current accident year and deterioration in prior year losses, predominantly Professional Indemnity. The segment reported a small profit for the year, with current year losses in Marine Hull and Marine Energy being offset by prior year reserve releases due to favourable claims experience. The segment showed a sizable loss as a result of further deterioration in the Professional Indemnity business line and a review of our Actuarial assumptions in Financial Institutions. This segment suffered from deterioration on prior year losses.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 4711 experienced an overall strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 82.874 million in 2018, representing 12.8% of opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by deterioration in prior year losses, notably within the Professional Indemnity business line and the Other including Global Casualty Insurance and Reinsurance segment. Additionally, a review of actuarial assumptions in Financial Institutions contributed to adverse development. These strengthenings were partially offset by prior year reserve releases due to favourable claims experience in the Marine, Energy & Aviation segment.
